args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Team,

I am writing to inquire about group booking availability for 10 people in June. We are planning a stay and would like to know about room options, rates, and any special group amenities.

Could you please provide information on availability for a group of 10 during June, as well as any requirements or procedures for group bookings?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
